scenes.role: core opening; Mara and Kit ask for a useful borrowed object
prerequisites: blanket is with its owner
actions: ask to borrow the blue blanket
promise to return it ready to use
consequences: custody changes to Mara while ownership stays with Aunt Salma
prose_obligations: show Mara’s care and Aunt Salma’s ordinary warning

prerequisites: blanket borrowed
actions: carry the blanket and picnic party to the meadow
consequences: party location changes to meadow
prose_obligations: make the riverside setting legible without narrating every handoff

scenes.role: setup consolidated with spreading the blanket
prerequisites: party reaches meadow
actions: choose a safer patch and spread the blanket
consequences: picnic and saved seat are established
prose_obligations: show the cousins making a place for Rowan

scenes.role: setup beat consolidated with spreading the blanket
prerequisites: blanket is spread
actions: leave a space for the late cousin
consequences: later arrival can be welcomed without inventing a seat offstage
prose_obligations: make the empty place feel intentional

prerequisites: picnic is spread
actions: unpack rolls, apples, and mint water
consequences: available food and crumbs are tracked
prose_obligations: show an ordinary lunch and one small imperfection

scenes.role: preparation consolidated into one short local play
prerequisites: basket brought to the meadow
actions: arrange food and napkins
consequences: lunch is prepared; blanket gets crumbs
prose_obligations: avoid making bookkeeping the scene

prerequisites: picnic is spread; gust has not passed; no other vignette used
actions: Kit tries a hollow reed as a whistle
consequences: Kit’s mood becomes playful and can color the arrival scene
prose_obligations: give the cousins a small shared joke

prerequisites: lunch prepared; gust not yet passed
actions: notice the river wind and react
consequences: gust response is enacted in local actions
prose_obligations: make the gust physically consequential

scenes.role: consequential choice consolidated with the gust encounter
prerequisites: gust threatens blanket and unlatched basket
actions: protect the blanket or catch the lunch, according to the validated priority parameter
consequences: the blanket’s condition and available rolls can diverge
prose_obligations: make the choice intelligible through the cousins’ motives, not rules dialogue

scenes.role: gust response consolidated with the choice
prerequisites: blanket can be held or anchored
actions: use stones or hands to keep the blanket from the water
consequences: dryness and anchoring are recorded
prose_obligations: show a physical action, not an unexplained outcome

prerequisites: basket is latched, caught, or left exposed
actions: secure the basket or let loose rolls scatter
consequences: food conservation determines the later lunch and ending
prose_obligations: never serve food that the chosen gust outcome lost

prerequisites: gust response complete
actions: wait through the stated delay
consequences: no unearned arrival occurs before the complication
prose_obligations: keep the wait human-scaled

prerequisites: gust has passed; Rowan has not arrived
actions: Rowan arrives after a bicycle-chain delay
consequences: cousin changes location and can be welcomed
prose_obligations: give Rowan a distinct voice and a reason for being late

prerequisites: Rowan has arrived; crumbs remain; no other vignette used
actions: offer spare crumbs to two sparrows
consequences: crumbs are consumed by an enacted action; later prose reflects whether birds were fed
prose_obligations: make this a brief moment of attention, not a hidden meal repair

prerequisites: Rowan arrived; lunch has not been shared
actions: explain what the gust did and what the cousins chose
consequences: honesty and trust are recorded with the meal
prose_obligations: do not blame the wind for the cousins’ choice

prerequisites: Rowan arrived and food is accounted for
actions: share saved rolls and fruit, or the remaining fruit if rolls were lost
consequences: meal kind, consumption, and welcome are recorded
prose_obligations: make the late cousin part of the meal, not a spectator

prerequisites: a truthful offer of food
actions: sit together and let Rowan join without an apology toll
consequences: cousin is welcomed; meal is complete
prose_obligations: resolve the ordinary hurt caused by the wait

scenes.role: ending action consolidated across all outcomes
prerequisites: meal shared; borrowed blanket still with Mara
actions: carry the blanket and picnic basket home
consequences: locations remain continuous
prose_obligations: do not end with custody still borrowed

prerequisites: blanket returned home, possibly wet or marked
actions: rinse and spread it on the sunny rail
consequences: borrowed object is useful and ready again
prose_obligations: show practical care rather than merely changing ownership

prerequisites: welcome complete and blanket clean and dry
actions: return the blanket and close the story according to the meal and gust outcome
consequences: dry feast, damp-blanket lunch, or fruit-and-crumb recovery
prose_obligations: give failure an emotionally complete ending as well as successful outcomes
